name: welder-social-manager
description: Post videos, photos, carousels and text to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Threads, Bluesky and X, now or on a schedule.

interface.longDescription: Make a post in Kimi and Welder puts it on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Threads, Bluesky and X, now or at a time you choose. You see every post before it goes live. Sign in to Welder and connect your own accounts; provider consent happens in your browser.

welder.description: Publishing, scheduling, analytics and comments for your connected social accounts

get-started.description: Connect social accounts and start your first workflow

publish-content.description: Post approved videos, photos, carousels and text

review-performance.description: Compare post results and plan what to try next
